description:
Can you hang on a bar for 1 minute? I want to challenge you.

I almost couldn’t do it!

On this episode of @themelrobbinspodcast, I’m joined by Dr. Brennan Spiegel, a leading gastroenterologist and medical researcher, who explains that your grip strength - even something as simple as hanging from a bar - is a powerful signal about your health.

Comment “Health” and I’ll DM you a link to the full episode.

Grip strength has been linked to your overall strength, your cardiovascular fitness, and even how long you’re likely to live.

Because when your body can hold itself up, resist gravity, and stay strong under load, everything functions better.

@brennan_spiegel breaks down what this simple test reveals and the small ways you can build strength to support your body for the long run.

🎧 “The Hidden Reason You Feel Exhausted & How to Feel Better Now”

Listen on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, or YouTube - search “Mel Robbins Podcast Brennan Spiegel”
